name: Lo and Behold
description:
About This Game

ADVENTURE AND COMFORT

Help rebuild Behold Village while befriending quirky animal folk. Decorate the village to your liking as it grows over time.

Unlock story moments, jam by the fire and go fishing at the local lake, enjoying the quiet life between journeys.

Upgrade your equipment and powers, expand shops and amenities, and prepare for your next adventure.

A BEAUTIFUL WORLD, MYSTERIOUSLY CORRUPTED

Venture into the unknown as the magical owl Lo, and rebuild a village of quirky animal folk. Uncover the mystery of the Guardians and their untimely corruption. Rescue characters, find lost relics and bring back treasures and resources to build a new home.

CRAFT YOUR ELEMENTAL CHAOS

Choose your favorite weapon and wield intuitive elemental powers to fight and cleanse corrupted beasts in quick, repeatable adventures. Gain power simply by playing your way, until you can defeat entire screens in flash of lightning, or play it safe and freeze any beast that gets too close.

A cozy-tinged adventure roguelike game about connection, restoration, and a powerful fight to keep a small village alive.
short_desc: Lo and Behold is a cozy tinged roguelike where you fight to protect a quirky village of animal folk. Venture out to fight corrupted beasts, use elemental powers to shape your own spells, and return with resources to rebuild and flourish Behold Village into a lively, magical home.
